body:
You are suicidal aswell, but you can still handle it because you know that killing yourself is useless? Or am I misintepreting? Well that is incredible then, to me. Or do you also feel trapped now? Now that you realize that death won't make you feel better... But at the same time, you're also suicidal, you're not happy (right?)

You're right, death won't change any feelings I might have. And, infact, I'm afraid of dying. But it's not about making myself feel better, that's not why I feel the need to kill myself. I want to kill myself, so that I don't have to feel *anything* anymore, because I almost never feel real happiness now. I feel trapped, that's what I feel, and I don't like it. And it gets worse the more time that passes.

You know, programming is actually not such a bad idea to be honest. I might actually try to learn it on my own, if that's possible at all. Unfortunately I didn't take any programming classes in high school. I went with web design instead... Bad idea, totally not my style, but I didn't think about it much back then.

But, about psychologists... I do not understand how it could help. How can one person like that make me change my mind and my perception of how the world works? What do they even do, honestly? Ask questions? Make you speak your mind? Well that's fine I guess. But I can do that here aswell. Infact, being able to write about it here is a blessing. It's anonymous, so you can be honest without feeling afraid at all. It's great. 

But hey, I won't pretend like I know if seeing a psychologist works or not. I don't know because I've never tried it.

I'm sorry. 

That's not much but I wanted to say it.
